source_record.method: Start with a concrete capability and its bearer, not a goal of obtaining a new property. List the actually needed parental functions and current directional arguments. Remove each represented parent, then each whole lineage including its overlapping aliases. Distinguish losing a function from losing a label: an adequate alternative can preserve the function. Compare the proposed criterion with the complete selected native meanings and their guards. A conjunction, new name, software wrapper or extra field is not automatically an induced property. These are reasoned removal/countercontext analyses, not executed causal ablations.
source_record.relation_limit: Current80guardedpremiseoccurrences78unique:69original/67unique retained plus11explicitly selected candidate3ports. No all-to-all, transitive or automatic use from a global M. Distinct rights remain distinct; new scopes are conditional native inputs.
source_record.parent_removal_semantics: In a strict functional removal, remove the claimed function rather than retain it under a new label; identify the resulting countercontext. In a lineage removal, remove every selected parent and alias in that lineage, then state which function is lost, supplied by an explicitly named remaining alternative, or still unresolved. A remaining lineage's ability to express the function is a subsumption observation, not proof of empirical superiority or automatic target adequacy.

candidates.candidate: Actionable evidence at distinct clocks with real commitment and resource limits

candidates.proposed_criterion: Each evidence item is used only for its actual claim and horizon; a still-actionable response is identified; the actual resource/commitment constraints remain visible; unresolved delayed outcomes are not replaced by a fast proxy without a valid relation.
candidates.mechanism: Real reserve/option feasibility constrains the response that feedback can support. Architecture exposes coupling and reversibility; feedback selection chooses a decision-relevant clock; proxy governance bounds delayed-outcome inference; a real gate locates the particular commitment.
